hints: What does the first value of the pre-order reading tell you, and what does finding that value in the in-order reading tell you?
The first pre-order value is the root; everything before it in the in-order reading is its left subtree and everything after is its right one. That gives you both subtrees' sizes.
With the sizes known, the pre-order reading splits too: the root, then exactly that many values for the left subtree, then the rest for the right. Now recurse on the two halves.
Finding the root's position by scanning is what makes this quadratic. Build a map from value to in-order position once, and every lookup becomes constant time.
